import ctypes, json, lzma, os, re, subprocess, sys, tarfile
# Upstream reference for the ts builtin: Debian's libtree-sitter 0.22.6 driven through ctypes, with the bundled grammar
# sources compiled in the guest (JSON ABI 14, TOML ABI 13 are loadable by 0.22; the Bash and Markdown grammars are ABI 15).
HELP = '/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w8-ts-grammars.tar.xz'
LANGS = ['json', 'toml']
class Node(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('ctx', ctypes.c_uint32 * 4), ('id', ctypes.c_void_p), ('tree', ctypes.c_void_p)]
class Point(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('row', ctypes.c_uint32), ('column', ctypes.c_uint32)]
class Edit(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('start_byte', ctypes.c_uint32), ('old_end_byte', ctypes.c_uint32), ('new_end_byte', ctypes.c_uint32),
                ('start_point', Point), ('old_end_point', Point), ('new_end_point', Point)]
class Cap(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('node', Node), ('index', ctypes.c_uint32)]
class Match(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('id', ctypes.c_uint32), ('pattern_index', ctypes.c_uint16), ('capture_count', ctypes.c_uint16), ('captures', ctypes.POINTER(Cap))]
def lib():
    t = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libtree-sitter.so.0')
    P = ctypes.c_void_p
    t.ts_parser_new.restype = P
    t.ts_parser_set_language.argtypes = [P, P]; t.ts_parser_set_language.restype = ctypes.c_bool
    t.ts_parser_parse_string.argtypes = [P, P, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint32]; t.ts_parser_parse_string.restype = P
    t.ts_tree_root_node.argtypes = [P]; t.ts_tree_root_node.restype = Node
    t.ts_tree_edit.argtypes = [P, ctypes.POINTER(Edit)]
    t.ts_node_string.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_string.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    t.ts_node_start_byte.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_start_byte.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
    t.ts_node_end_byte.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_end_byte.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
    t.ts_node_start_point.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_start_point.restype = Point
    t.ts_node_end_point.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_end_point.restype = Point
    t.ts_query_new.argtypes = [P, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]; t.ts_query_new.restype = P
    t.ts_query_cursor_new.restype = P
    t.ts_query_cursor_exec.argtypes = [P, P, Node]
    t.ts_query_cursor_next_match.argtypes = [P, ctypes.POINTER(Match)]; t.ts_query_cursor_next_match.restype = ctypes.c_bool
    t.ts_query_capture_name_for_id.argtypes = [P, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32)]; t.ts_query_capture_name_for_id.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
    return t
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None)
libc.free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
def build():
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=lzma.open(HELP)) as t:
        t.extractall('grammars', members=[m for m in t.getmembers() if m.name.split('/')[0] in LANGS], filter='data')
    for l in LANGS:
        srcs = ['grammar.c'] + (['scanner.c'] if os.path.exists('grammars/%s/scanner.c' % l) else [])
        r = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/gcc', '-O0', '-g0', '-w', '-shared', '-fPIC', '-I.', '-o', '../../libts_%s.so' % l] + srcs,
                           cwd='grammars/' + l, env={'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin'}, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(l, 'gcc rc', r.returncode, r.stderr[:300])
def language(t, l):
    so = ctypes.CDLL('./libts_%s.so' % l)
    fn = getattr(so, 'tree_sitter_' + l)
    fn.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    return fn()
def parse(t, l, data, old=None):
    p = t.ts_parser_new()
    assert t.ts_parser_set_language(p, language(t, l)), 'set_language failed'
    return t.ts_parser_parse_string(p, old, data, len(data))
def sexp(t, tree):
    s = t.ts_node_string(t.ts_tree_root_node(tree))
    out = ctypes.string_at(s).decode()
    libc.free(s)
    return out
def run_query(t, l, tree, q, data):
    err, et = ctypes.c_uint32(0), ctypes.c_int(0)
    qq = t.ts_query_new(language(t, l), q.encode(), len(q.encode()), ctypes.byref(err), ctypes.byref(et))
    assert qq, 'query error %d at %d' % (et.value, err.value)
    cur = t.ts_query_cursor_new()
    t.ts_query_cursor_exec(cur, qq, t.ts_tree_root_node(tree))
    m = Match()
    rows = []
    while t.ts_query_cursor_next_match(cur, ctypes.byref(m)):
        for i in range(m.capture_count):
            c = m.captures[i]
            ln = ctypes.c_uint32(0)
            name = t.ts_query_capture_name_for_id(qq, c.index, ctypes.byref(ln))[:ln.value].decode()
            sp, ep = t.ts_node_start_point(c.node), t.ts_node_end_point(c.node)
            sb, eb = t.ts_node_start_byte(c.node), t.ts_node_end_byte(c.node)
            tx = sb
            while tx < eb and tx < len(data) and data[tx] != 10:
                tx += 1
            rows.append((name, sp.row + 1, sp.column + 1, ep.row + 1, ep.column + 1, sb, eb, data[sb:tx].decode('utf8', 'replace')))
    return rows
def point(data, off):
    pre = data[:off]
    return Point(pre.count(b'\n'), off - (pre.rfind(b'\n') + 1))
def edit_args(old, new):
    n = min(len(old), len(new))
    p = 0
    while p < n and old[p] == new[p]:
        p += 1
    s = 0
    while s < n - p and old[len(old) - 1 - s] == new[len(new) - 1 - s]:
        s += 1
    return p, len(old) - s, len(new) - s
def rd(n):
    return open(n, 'rb').read()
def wr(n, s):
    open(n, 'w').write(s)
def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == 'build':
        build(); return
    t = lib()
    corpus = json.load(open('corpus.json'))
    out = []
    if mode == 'prep':
        for name, e in corpus['edits'].items():
            a, b, c = edit_args(e['old'].encode(), e['new'].encode())
            wr('edit.%s.args' % name, '%d %d %d\n' % (a, b, c))
        return
    kind = sys.argv[2]
    for name, d in (corpus['parse'].items() if kind == 'parse' else []):
        data = d['src'].encode()
        ref = sexp(t, parse(t, d['lang'], data))
        cand = rd('cand.%s.parse' % name).decode().rstrip('\n') if os.path.exists('cand.%s.parse' % name) else None
        ok = bool(ref) and ref.startswith('(') and ((('ERROR' in ref) or ('MISSING' in ref)) == bool(d.get('error')))
        out.append('parse %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if cand == ref else 'DIFFER', 'ref-ok' if ok else 'ref-bad'))
    for name, d in (corpus['queries'].items() if kind == 'query' else []):
        data = corpus['parse'][d['doc']]['src'].encode()
        tree = parse(t, d['lang'], data)
        rows = run_query(t, d['lang'], tree, d['q'], data)
        ref = ''.join('%s %d:%d-%d:%d %d-%d %s\n' % r for r in rows)
        cand = rd('cand.%s.query' % name).decode('utf8', 'replace') if os.path.exists('cand.%s.query' % name) else None
        out.append('query %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if cand == ref else 'DIFFER', 'ref-has-%s' % ('captures' if rows else 'none')))
    for name, d in (corpus['highlights'].items() if kind == 'query' else []):
        data = corpus['parse'][d['doc']]['src'].encode()
        tree = parse(t, d['lang'], data)
        rows = run_query(t, d['lang'], tree, corpus['scm'][d['lang']], data)
        ref = sorted({(r[5], r[6], r[0]) for r in rows})
        cand = []
        if os.path.exists('cand.%s.hl' % name):
            for ln in rd('cand.%s.hl' % name).decode().splitlines():
                m = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+) \S+ (.+)$', ln)
                if m:
                    cand.append((int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)))
        out.append('highlight %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if sorted(set(cand)) == ref else 'DIFFER', 'ref-has-%s' % ('captures' if ref else 'none')))
    for name, e in (corpus['edits'].items() if kind == 'edit' else []):
        old, new = e['old'].encode(), e['new'].encode()
        a, b, c = edit_args(old, new)
        tr = parse(t, e['lang'], old)
        ed = Edit(a, b, c, point(old, a), point(old, b), point(new, c))
        t.ts_tree_edit(tr, ctypes.byref(ed))
        inc = sexp(t, parse(t, e['lang'], new, tr))
        fresh = sexp(t, parse(t, e['lang'], new))
        cand = rd('cand.%s.edit' % name).decode().rstrip('\n') if os.path.exists('cand.%s.edit' % name) else None
        out.append('edit %s %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if cand == inc else 'DIFFER', 'ref-ok' if inc.startswith('(') else 'ref-bad', 'matches-fresh' if inc == fresh else 'differs-from-fresh'))
    wr('result', '\n'.join(out) + '\n')
main()

cases.oracle: Upstream tree-sitter runtime (Debian libtree-sitter 0.22.6, driven through ctypes) with the bundled JSON (ABI 14) and TOML (ABI 13) grammar sources compiled in the guest, versus the ts builtin's vendored runtime. The reference is a different runtime build; the grammar tables are the bundled revisions. Bash and Markdown grammars are ABI 15 and cannot be loaded by 0.22, so they are not covered here.
cases.comparison: Per document: the builtin output equals the upstream runtime output byte for byte (S-expressions / capture lines / capture set / incremental-edit tree); every line also records that the reference produced a non-empty, well-formed result.

        inc = sexp(t, parse(t, e['lang'], new, tr))
        fresh = sexp(t, parse(t, e['lang'], new))
        cand = rd('cand.%s.edit' % name).decode().rstrip('\n') if os.path.exists('cand.%s.edit' % name) else None
        out.append('edit %s %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if cand == inc else 'DIFFER', 'ref-ok' if inc.startswith('(') else 'ref-bad', 'matches-fresh' if inc == fresh else 'differs-from-fresh'))
    wr('result', '\n'.join(out) + '\n')
main()

import ctypes, json, lzma, os, re, subprocess, sys, tarfile
# Upstream reference for the ts builtin: Debian's libtree-sitter 0.22.6 driven through ctypes, with the bundled grammar
# sources compiled in the guest (JSON ABI 14, TOML ABI 13 are loadable by 0.22; the Bash and Markdown grammars are ABI 15).
HELP = '/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w8-ts-grammars.tar.xz'
LANGS = ['json', 'toml']
class Node(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('ctx', ctypes.c_uint32 * 4), ('id', ctypes.c_void_p), ('tree', ctypes.c_void_p)]
class Point(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('row', ctypes.c_uint32), ('column', ctypes.c_uint32)]
class Edit(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('start_byte', ctypes.c_uint32), ('old_end_byte', ctypes.c_uint32), ('new_end_byte', ctypes.c_uint32),
                ('start_point', Point), ('old_end_point', Point), ('new_end_point', Point)]
class Cap(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('node', Node), ('index', ctypes.c_uint32)]
class Match(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('id', ctypes.c_uint32), ('pattern_index', ctypes.c_uint16), ('capture_count', ctypes.c_uint16), ('captures', ctypes.POINTER(Cap))]
def lib():
    t = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libtree-sitter.so.0')
    P = ctypes.c_void_p
    t.ts_parser_new.restype = P
    t.ts_parser_set_language.argtypes = [P, P]; t.ts_parser_set_language.restype = ctypes.c_bool
    t.ts_parser_parse_string.argtypes = [P, P, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint32]; t.ts_parser_parse_string.restype = P
    t.ts_tree_root_node.argtypes = [P]; t.ts_tree_root_node.restype = Node
    t.ts_tree_edit.argtypes = [P, ctypes.POINTER(Edit)]
    t.ts_node_string.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_string.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    t.ts_node_start_byte.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_start_byte.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
    t.ts_node_end_byte.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_end_byte.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
    t.ts_node_start_point.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_start_point.restype = Point
    t.ts_node_end_point.argtypes = [Node]; t.ts_node_end_point.restype = Point
    t.ts_query_new.argtypes = [P, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]; t.ts_query_new.restype = P
    t.ts_query_cursor_new.restype = P
    t.ts_query_cursor_exec.argtypes = [P, P, Node]
    t.ts_query_cursor_next_match.argtypes = [P, ctypes.POINTER(Match)]; t.ts_query_cursor_next_match.restype = ctypes.c_bool
    t.ts_query_capture_name_for_id.argtypes = [P, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32)]; t.ts_query_capture_name_for_id.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
    return t
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None)
libc.free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
def build():
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=lzma.open(HELP)) as t:
        t.extractall('grammars', members=[m for m in t.getmembers() if m.name.split('/')[0] in LANGS], filter='data')
    for l in LANGS:
        srcs = ['grammar.c'] + (['scanner.c'] if os.path.exists('grammars/%s/scanner.c' % l) else [])
        r = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/gcc', '-O0', '-g0', '-w', '-shared', '-fPIC', '-I.', '-o', '../../libts_%s.so' % l] + srcs,
                           cwd='grammars/' + l, env={'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin'}, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(l, 'gcc rc', r.returncode, r.stderr[:300])
def language(t, l):
    so = ctypes.CDLL('./libts_%s.so' % l)
    fn = getattr(so, 'tree_sitter_' + l)
    fn.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    return fn()
def parse(t, l, data, old=None):
    p = t.ts_parser_new()
    assert t.ts_parser_set_language(p, language(t, l)), 'set_language failed'
    return t.ts_parser_parse_string(p, old, data, len(data))
def sexp(t, tree):
    s = t.ts_node_string(t.ts_tree_root_node(tree))
    out = ctypes.string_at(s).decode()
    libc.free(s)
    return out
def run_query(t, l, tree, q, data):
    err, et = ctypes.c_uint32(0), ctypes.c_int(0)
    qq = t.ts_query_new(language(t, l), q.encode(), len(q.encode()), ctypes.byref(err), ctypes.byref(et))
    assert qq, 'query error %d at %d' % (et.value, err.value)
    cur = t.ts_query_cursor_new()
    t.ts_query_cursor_exec(cur, qq, t.ts_tree_root_node(tree))
    m = Match()
    rows = []
    while t.ts_query_cursor_next_match(cur, ctypes.byref(m)):
        for i in range(m.capture_count):
            c = m.captures[i]
            ln = ctypes.c_uint32(0)
            name = t.ts_query_capture_name_for_id(qq, c.index, ctypes.byref(ln))[:ln.value].decode()
            sp, ep = t.ts_node_start_point(c.node), t.ts_node_end_point(c.node)
            sb, eb = t.ts_node_start_byte(c.node), t.ts_node_end_byte(c.node)
            tx = sb
            while tx < eb and tx < len(data) and data[tx] != 10:
                tx += 1
            rows.append((name, sp.row + 1, sp.column + 1, ep.row + 1, ep.column + 1, sb, eb, data[sb:tx].decode('utf8', 'replace')))
    return rows
def point(data, off):
    pre = data[:off]
    return Point(pre.count(b'\n'), off - (pre.rfind(b'\n') + 1))
def edit_args(old, new):
    n = min(len(old), len(new))
    p = 0
    while p < n and old[p] == new[p]:
        p += 1
    s = 0
    while s < n - p and old[len(old) - 1 - s] == new[len(new) - 1 - s]:
        s += 1
    return p, len(old) - s, len(new) - s
def rd(n):
    return open(n, 'rb').read()
def wr(n, s):
    open(n, 'w').write(s)
def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == 'build':
        build(); return
    t = lib()
    corpus = json.load(open('corpus.json'))
    out = []
    if mode == 'prep':
        for name, e in corpus['edits'].items():
            a, b, c = edit_args(e['old'].encode(), e['new'].encode())
            wr('edit.%s.args' % name, '%d %d %d\n' % (a, b, c))
        return
    kind = sys.argv[2]
    for name, d in (corpus['parse'].items() if kind == 'parse' else []):
        data = d['src'].encode()
        ref = sexp(t, parse(t, d['lang'], data))
        cand = rd('cand.%s.parse' % name).decode().rstrip('\n') if os.path.exists('cand.%s.parse' % name) else None
        ok = bool(ref) and ref.startswith('(') and ((('ERROR' in ref) or ('MISSING' in ref)) == bool(d.get('error')))
        out.append('parse %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if cand == ref else 'DIFFER', 'ref-ok' if ok else 'ref-bad'))
    for name, d in (corpus['queries'].items() if kind == 'query' else []):
        data = corpus['parse'][d['doc']]['src'].encode()
        tree = parse(t, d['lang'], data)
        rows = run_query(t, d['lang'], tree, d['q'], data)
        ref = ''.join('%s %d:%d-%d:%d %d-%d %s\n' % r for r in rows)
        cand = rd('cand.%s.query' % name).decode('utf8', 'replace') if os.path.exists('cand.%s.query' % name) else None
        out.append('query %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if cand == ref else 'DIFFER', 'ref-has-%s' % ('captures' if rows else 'none')))
    for name, d in (corpus['highlights'].items() if kind == 'query' else []):
        data = corpus['parse'][d['doc']]['src'].encode()
        tree = parse(t, d['lang'], data)
        rows = run_query(t, d['lang'], tree, corpus['scm'][d['lang']], data)
        ref = sorted({(r[5], r[6], r[0]) for r in rows})
        cand = []
        if os.path.exists('cand.%s.hl' % name):
            for ln in rd('cand.%s.hl' % name).decode().splitlines():
                m = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+) \S+ (.+)$', ln)
                if m:
                    cand.append((int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)))
        out.append('highlight %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if sorted(set(cand)) == ref else 'DIFFER', 'ref-has-%s' % ('captures' if ref else 'none')))
    for name, e in (corpus['edits'].items() if kind == 'edit' else []):
        old, new = e['old'].encode(), e['new'].encode()
        a, b, c = edit_args(old, new)
        tr = parse(t, e['lang'], old)
        ed = Edit(a, b, c, point(old, a), point(old, b), point(new, c))
        t.ts_tree_edit(tr, ctypes.byref(ed))
        inc = sexp(t, parse(t, e['lang'], new, tr))
        fresh = sexp(t, parse(t, e['lang'], new))
        cand = rd('cand.%s.edit' % name).decode().rstrip('\n') if os.path.exists('cand.%s.edit' % name) else None
        out.append('edit %s %s %s %s' % (name, 'equal' if cand == inc else 'DIFFER', 'ref-ok' if inc.startswith('(') else 'ref-bad', 'matches-fresh' if inc == fresh else 'differs-from-fresh'))
    wr('result', '\n'.join(out) + '\n')
main()
